text:
Ana (PM): Quick sync — multiple enterprise customers have asked for an 'inference advisor' that: suggests batching/caching/quant profiles per route, estimates cost/latency impact, and raises eval-triggered alerts for quality regressions. Need to pick MVP scope + launch gates. Opinions?

Raj (Eng): Rules-first MVP makes sense. Heuristics + cost model + rule engine is fast to ship. ML ranker can follow in Q2.

Lucy (ML): +1 to rules-first. We do need a minimal eval hook so customers don't get noisy alerts. I can prototype a single signal: delta-perplexity or top-k token shift.

Zoe (CS): Customer asks: a) a one-click 'apply recommendation' for dedicated capacity customers, b) PDF/CSV report for execs, c) an opt-out for auto-apply.

Mike (Solutions): Also ask for a "concierge" path for >$50k customers: recommendations reviewed by a solutions engineer before apply.

Ana (PM): Proposed MVP scope: 1) Recommendation engine (rules) for batching + prefix KV cache + two quantization profiles (safe / aggressive). 2) Console view + CSV export. 3) Eval-alerts: single metric + weekly backfill. 4) Canary rollout API + telemetry. Launch gates?

Raj (Eng): Suggest measurable gates: - telemetry coverage >= 90% of requests for target routes - recommendation accuracy estimate: predicted cost saving vs measured within ±20% for at least 30% of sampled routes - alert false positive rate < 7% (based on initial eval set)

Lucy (ML): For alert gating we should define: metric = mean token-shift over probe prompts. Gate: precision @ alert threshold >= 0.8 on our eval set. I can run a sweep this week.

Zoe (CS): Also require customer acceptance criteria: customers in pilot must see >= 5% p50 latency improvement or >=10% cost reduction for their traffic mix, otherwise we don't mark pilot as successful.

Raj (Eng): Implementation notes: need a lightweight offline simulator to estimate batching gains given latency SLO. Prototype CLI: \n```\nsimulate-batching --latency-slo 150 --profile routeA.log --batch-window 10ms\n```\nResults feed into recommendation score.

Ana (PM): Risk log: - noisy alerts -> mistrust - wrong quant profile -> quality regressions - overpromising cost savings on mixed workloads. Mitigations: conservative defaults, preview mode, mandatory canary percentage, email + console warnings.

Mike (Solutions): For concierge customers we should include a manual review step + a rollback widget in console. Also add a preflight check that runs evals on a sampled prefix.

Raj (Eng): Can we reuse the Optimize telemetry pipeline? If not, estimate 2 sprints to add sampling + new telemetry fields.

Lucy (ML): I'll deliver a minimal metric evaluation and a small set of probe prompts. Plan: prototype metric + threshold suggestions by EOW.

deploy-bot: canary deployed branch optimize-advisor/rules-mvp to staging (job 9876) :rocket:

Ana (PM): Next steps: 1) Lucy prototype + thresholds, 2) Raj estimate infra work and telemetry sprint, 3) Zoe run customer pilot list + acceptance criteria, 4) Mike define concierge flow. Check-in Friday 11am. :thumbsup:

Zoe (CS): Sounds good, I'll ping the pilot customers now and collect sample routes.

Raj (Eng): I'll draft the gating metrics doc and post PR by tomorrow.

Lucy (ML): uploading eval probes to staging bucket after my run, will post results in this thread. :white_check_mark:
